contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN] VALENT [I]ANVS PF AVG ; R/ [GL]ORI[A RO]MANORVM

: Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Arles mint Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [DN] VALENT [I]ANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. Letters OF II in field. Reverse inscription: [GL]ORI[A RO]MANORVM. Diameter: 18.01mm,…
